description.value: Fresh St. Market is a BC-based supermarket chain with a strong emphasis on fresh and locally sourced products. The West Vancouver location on Marine Drive is a full-service store spanning two floors with departments ranging from a full deli and prepared foods counter to fresh seafood, bakery, floral, and a broad international foods selection. For a touring cyclist on the Sea-to-Sky corridor or the North Shore, it represents a well-stocked resupply point with a wide variety of food options.
